name: Sacred/Profane
source:
Sacred/Profane is an erotic visual novel about a young woman named Sophie and her obsession with BDSM and public nudity. All her life, Sophie's been worried she'll be outed and shunned by her evangelical community for her perverse passions. But when a mysterious woman offers her the chance to satisfy her sexual desires, Sophie will need to make the toughest choice she's ever faced. Will she indulge her bisexuality and love of BDSM, sealing her fate as a deviant and pariah in the eyes of her community? Or will she give it all up and reluctantly accept the social stability of a traditional relationship?

[From [url=https://midnightarrow.itch.io/sacredprofane]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Sacred/Profane》是一部情色视觉小说，讲述年轻女子索菲对BDSM与公开裸露的痴迷。一直以来，索菲都担心自己的特殊欲望被揭穿，遭到所在福音派社群的排斥。

然而，一名神秘女子向她提供了满足性欲的机会，让索菲不得不面对人生中最艰难的抉择。她会顺从自己的双性恋倾向与对BDSM的热爱，从此被社群视作离经叛道的异类吗？还是放弃这一切，勉强接受传统伴侣关系所带来的社会安稳？

[摘自[url=https://midnightarrow.itch.io/sacredprofane]Itch.io[/url]]
